## What

One sentence on what this change does.

## Why

The problem or requirement this change addresses. Link the issue or
the requirement if there is one.

## How

The approach taken, and any decisions that matter. Keep it short;
point to code rather than repeating it.

## Verification

- Which checks passed (render, ua2, CodeQL, analyze, commit
  subjects)
- What you tested locally before pushing (unit tests, smoke,
  renders)
- Any evidence a reviewer should re-check

## Notes

Anything a reviewer must know: deliberate simplifications, known
limits, follow-up work planned separately.
